verdict.rationale: First-party docs tell developers to point any OpenAI SDK at https://api.morphllm.com/v1 with one API key, and say existing OpenAI code only needs a new model string. The llms.txt probe confirms the base URL and states 'OpenAI-compatible.' A community user independently reports getting the OpenAI-compatible endpoint working with their own CLI tool. Missing for 10: documented compatibility detail (which OpenAI parameters or features are supported or unsupported) and a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404).
